name: browser/news
title: Today's news
summary: Today's news on a topic: search with dates, read dated sources, keep only items from the asked period, cite each.
when: Use when the user asks what is happening now or this week on a topic and wants dated news rather than evergreen pages.
steps: Write the topic and the asked period, today, this week or exact dates, in one line first.
Call multi_search with queries holding two or three phrases that name the topic and the period, and max_results 6.
Read the titles and snippets for dates, and call fetch_pages with urls set to up to five pages whose date fits the period.
Read the date printed on each page and keep only items published inside the asked period; note each date.
Call web_research with query set to the topic and depth 3 when the search list has no dated articles.
If no dated article falls inside the period, say so plainly and give the closest older item with its date.
Answer with one line per item: what happened, its date, and the citation [1] with the URL.
next: The final answer must list each news item with its date and a numbered citation [1], [2] and the URLs, and say plainly when nothing dated was found for the period.
